title: Publish a research report to a CMS

visible.description: Turn a research brief into a published report page in a content management system, with a concise title, required sections, a source link, a cover image, and correct metadata.
when_to_use: A user asks for a report to be published on a website or CMS.
The report must include findings, sources, and a cover image.
A test account or API token is available for the CMS.

workflow: Confirm that a CMS endpoint and authorization are available.
Inspect existing pages to avoid duplicate titles and slugs.
Create a draft with a unique lowercase hyphenated slug and a title of at most 60 characters.
Upload a cover image with alt text.
Add Summary, Method, Findings, and Sources sections; include every required point and at least one source URL.
Read the public page back and confirm status, title, slug, metadata, sections, source, and image.
If publishing times out, retry once; if authorization is missing, stop and escalate.

source.redaction_notes: No raw user request attached. Synthetic benchmark seed; review required before gold.
